items_missed: 1_set_agenda: no 'How are you today?', no real agenda statement (what we'll cover + rough time), no explicit 'sound good?' confirmation
2_probe: never asked about special considerations (tight turns/narrow hallways), never asked about packing needs, never asked about moving stressors/worries

3_pricing: never named No Worries Damage Coverage ($2,000 protection) by name, never mentioned Meet Your Mover, never mentioned the On-Time Guarantee, no explicit 'no hidden fees' rundown (credit card fee, fuel surcharge, assembly fee)
5_estimate: no stated typical time range for a move this size, number of trucks never confirmed (only crew size), stairs/elevator and walk distance not tied back to the estimate as variables
6_save_your_ass: entire prep speech skipped -- no 'prep = shorter move = lower bill' framing, no consolidation examples, no 'take a carload' tip
7_quote_booking: never gave business hours or how to reach the branch
8_politeness: used the customer's name ('Crystal') only twice, short of the 3+ bar
9_bonus: never explained the insurance program specifics (No Worries name + 60 cents/lb baseline) -- only a vague 'liability coverage' mention
top_strength: Jespah proactively re-ran the numbers across branches mid-call to save the customer money -- "Scratch what I just said, it's actually better more cost efficient if we move this through the lender branch" -- and built real rapport with the angel-numbers banter, which visibly warmed Crystal up before booking.
coaching_note: The Save Your Ass prep speech was skipped entirely -- that's 10 points and it's the section that actually shortens moves and lowers the bill, so build it into every call once you land on the estimate. Also name the differentiators specifically: No Worries Damage Coverage, Meet Your Mover, and the On-Time Guarantee never came up, and customers need to hear those by name, not just "liability coverage." Open with a real agenda statement ("here's what we'll cover, takes about 10-15 minutes, sound good?") and an "how are you today" so the call feels less like straight data entry from the jump.
phone_presence_notes: Genuine rapport in the angel-numbers exchange and a warm close, but most of the call was matter-of-fact info-gathering with few affirmations in between.
